_about: Registry of the clips in the problem-segment study (research/diagnose.py). eye = what the user said about the Gyroflow result: bad / good / unknown. lens_profile = Gyroflow lens JSON for the image pass when the camera does not wear the lens its telemetry describes (null = clip metadata). Header facts (camera, firmware, serial) were read from the files.
